integrity: Exact analytical theorem and reproducible finite checks; asymptotics, almost-sure limits and sharpness are proved rather than inferred from simulations.
scientific_limitations: Real Gaussian TT cores, identical first-k-core reuse and mutually independent suffix cores only.
Uniform variance bound is for deterministic real symmetric positive-semidefinite targets, with equality attained on separable rank-one projectors.
Nonconsistency is proved for separable rank-one targets, not for every nonzero target.
No direct extension to complex cores, indefinite matrices, orthogonalized cores or finite-precision errors.
Unknown unindexed prior work remains a bibliographic risk; no independent validation is claimed.
title: Sharp shared-prefix variance law for Gaussian tensor-train trace probes
